Dense batch layout

Source: R/graph-transformers.R
to_dense_batch.Rd

Reorganizes node rows of a batch into a padded B by L by F tensor, where L is the largest graph size, plus a B by L logical mask of real nodes. from_dense_batch() inverts it.

Usage

to_dense_batch(x, batch)

from_dense_batch(dense)

Arguments

x

Node feature tensor (N by F).

batch

Graph membership (integer vector, 1:B, nodes of a graph contiguous as produced by graph_batch()).

dense

Result of to_dense_batch() with x replaced by a new B by L by F' tensor.

Value

A list with x, mask and index (the flat positions).
